item.title: AST SpaceMobile's new satellite to ride Blue Origin's 'New Glenn' rocket
item.description: Blue Origin said New Glenn, its heavy duty rocket, will carry AST SpaceMobile's next-gen 'Block 2 Bluebird' satellite into low-Earth orbit. #pressrelease

item.title: Bezos' Blue Origin readies 6-terabit super satellite constellation
item.description: Blue Origin will target enterprises, including data centers, with 'TeraWave,' a planned network of 5,408 low-Earth and medium-Earth orbit satellites that will pack about 6 Tbit/s of capacity.

item.title: Google paves way for Thailand's AI growth with new cloud region
item.description: A new cloud region, based in Bangkok, aims to provide local businesses with a gateway to Google's AI ecosystem.

item.title: Ericsson CEO warns of more cuts as 5G market stays 'flat'
item.description: In the absence of a sales boost from 5G-powered humanoids, Ericsson continues to work on improving profitability by cutting jobs.

item.title: Eurobites: Telefónica Tech lands smart-meter gig with Aguas de Cádiz
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: MTN Nigeria tots up the fiber cuts; STL, Colt combine on multi-core fiber trials; when not to use your phone in Finland.

item.title: The Buildout: Spectrum expands in Ohio and Kentucky
item.description: This week in broadband builds: Spectrum launches in even more federally funded regions; GoNetspeed grows network in Manchester, Connecticut; Lightcurve expands in Washington – and more.

item.title: Charter refusing to sign or renew wholesale deals with WISPs, org claims
item.description: As the Charter-Cox deal faces FCC review, WISPA has warned that Charter has refused sign new 'upstream wholesale services' agreements or renew existing ones with wireless Internet service providers.

item.title: Giuseppe Commisso named Mediacom's interim CEO
item.description: Mediacom has appointed Giuseppe Commisso to vice chairman and interim CEO following the passing of company founder and CEO Rocco Commisso. Giuseppe Commisso, a member of Mediacom board, most recently served as the operator's group VP of corporate finance. #pressrelease

item.title: Jason Hansen named CIO of Conway
item.description: Jason Hansen has been named Conway Corp's chief information officer. He had been the company's CTO since 2011. #pressrelease

item.title: FCC, ISPs prep for Fern disruptions
item.description: Winter Storm Fern is headed to a region near you, with more than 30 states bracing for impact. Communications providers are preparing for disruption and reminding those with compatible devices to use satellite messaging as needed.
